text: At its virtual meeting held on November 24, 2020, the Toronto Police Services Board (Board) was in receipt of a report, dated November 11, 2020, from Ryan Teschner, Executive Director & Chief of Staff, with respect to the above noted matter. The Board approved the foregoing report and agreed to forward a copy to the City’s Executive Committee to allocate and transfer to the Board additional funding for the Review in an amount not to exceed $700,000, and request that such funds be made available to the Board as of the date of the request, and until the conclusion of the Review. A copy of Board Minute No. P185/2020 regarding this matter is attached.
The Executive Committee referred Item EX19.23 to the Budget Committee for consideration in the 2021 Budget process.
